training.narrative: Canonical Scryfall art crops already cached for the CLIP gallery. Training views are randomized crop error, perspective, blur, glare, sleeve, exposure, noise, JPEG, and background. Positives are the frozen CLIP vectors of the clean canonical image. Negatives are in-batch cards plus eight nearest incorrect gallery cards, mined once from raw CLIP and once more after the first adapter round. Train, dev, and stress oracles are disjoint. The Samsung stills were not used as training or augmentation sources. Dual weights, when run, were chosen on synthetic dev only.

device: Each adapter is about 1.0 MB of float32 and one 512-wide GEMM, well under a millisecond after the embedding exists. It can later be a MatMul + Add + L2 normalize in the existing ONNX Runtime stack. The cost that remains is frozen CLIP ViT-B/32, about 85 MB quantized and about 100 ms per image on this host CPU. Android integration was not added.

verdictWhy: B1 art linear is 32/46 Top1 and 35/46 Top3 versus current CLIP 23/46 and 25/46. It recovers Basilisk Collar, Sword of Hearth and Home, and Wand of Wonder, with no Top1 regressions and wrong-confident 2/46 versus 1/46. Full-card adapters are 20/46 and 19/46. Dual is 34/46, two frames above B1, which does not change the decision.
next: Keep the frozen CLIP encoder, deploy the B1 linear art adapter, and rebuild the canonical art gallery with it. Do not fine-tune the encoder yet.
